title: Settings
subtitle: Profile, preferences and security in one place.

cruisePreferences.title: Cruise preferences
cruisePreferences.description: Defaults for newly created cruises and how they render on the map.
cruisePreferences.defaultLineHint: Prefilled in "New cruise → Manual" when no ship is picked.
cruisePreferences.showArcs: Show cruise routes on the map
cruisePreferences.showArcsHint: Bezier lines between departure and arrival ports in the dashboard map.

lodgingPreferences.title: Lodging preferences
lodgingPreferences.description: Base currency for lodging stats and spend totals.
lodgingPreferences.baseCurrencyHint: Every stay is converted into this currency at the ECB rate for its check-in day. Already-saved stays keep their original conversion rate — a change only affects future calculations.

geocoder.title: Geocoder
geocoder.description: Admins only: configure this instance's address search and coordinate resolution.
geocoder.photonUrlHint: Used for live search-as-you-type (e.g. the lodging or trip location picker). Leave empty to use the public default, photon.komoot.io.
geocoder.nominatimUrlHint: Used for one-shot geocoding requests. Leave empty to use the public default, nominatim.openstreetmap.org.
geocoder.saveError: Failed to save the geocoder settings.
geocoder.loadError: Failed to load the geocoder settings.
geocoder.testEmpty: Connection successful, but no hits for "Berlin".
geocoder.testError: Connection failed. Please check the URL and reachability.

about.buildVersionHint: Version that was baked into the container image at build time. This only differs from the displayed version when a promoted RC is running.

profile.title: User Profile
profile.description: Adjust username, contact information and your profile picture.
profile.birthdateHint: Optional. Only used for the "Birthday Flight" achievement — day and month are compared against a flight's departure date.

help.title: Profile & password
help.description: Username, email and profile picture are only visible to you. The email is also used for password reset and optional notifications.
help.avatar: PNG or JPG, max. 5 MB. Stored locally in the database — never sent to an external service.
help.password: Opens a separate modal that requires the current password for verification before a new one can be set.

homeAirport.title: Home airport
homeAirport.description: Your base airport. Used in statistics — for example to compute distance from home, or to exclude returns home from layover stats.
homeAirport.fromDateHint: Flights before this date keep counting the previous home airport — a move never rewrites history.
homeAirport.loadError: Failed to load home airport history.
homeAirport.bannerDescription: Set your home airport so stats like "longest layover" or "farthest from home" work correctly.

help.title: Home airport & relocations
help.description: The home airport anchors travel statistics. Flights departing from or returning to home are not layovers by definition.
help.historyExplained: When you move, the previous airport is preserved as a past entry — old flights still use the old home airport.

display.title: Display & Language
display.description: Control language, timezone, and date/time formats centrally.

units.title: Units & Formats
units.description: Define the standard units for statistics.

help.title: Units & formats
help.description: Controls how distances and costs are displayed throughout the app — dashboard, statistics, flight details and exports.
help.distance: Kilometers (EU standard), miles (US) or nautical miles (as used by airlines). The underlying calculation stays the same — only the display changes.
help.currency: Used for ticket prices and cost statistics. No automatic conversion of existing flights — old values remain stored in their original currency.

defaults.title: Default Values
defaults.description: New flights will be created with these defaults.

help.title: Defaults for new flights
help.description: These values are pre-selected when you add a flight manually or import one from email. You can still edit every individual flight afterwards.
help.status: "Scheduled" makes sense for upcoming flights; "Flown" is convenient when quickly entering past flights.
help.category: Business / private / vacation — only relevant for your statistics, has no effect on live data or cost calculation.

help.title: Notifications
help.description: Control which events you want to be notified about via email. The actual SMTP configuration lives in the admin area.
help.email: Requires a verified email address in your profile. Without SMTP set up in the admin panel, this option has no effect even when enabled.
help.reminders: Flight reminders are sent 24 h or 48 h before departure depending on the selected option. Check-in reminders require an airline integration.
help.privacy: Notifications are triggered locally — no data is sent to any external service outside your own SMTP server.

smtpHelp.title: Set up SMTP server
smtpHelp.description: TravStats sends password reset links and notifications through an SMTP server. Without a valid SMTP configuration these features are disabled.
smtpHelp.ports: 587 + STARTTLS (standard, leave "Secure (TLS)" off), 465 + implicit TLS (turn "Secure (TLS)" on), 25 only for local unauthenticated relays.
smtpHelp.credentials: Gmail/Outlook require app passwords instead of the account password (2FA is a prerequisite). Self-hosted Postfix servers typically allow SMTP-AUTH with a system user.
smtpHelp.sender: The From email should match the SMTP server's domain — otherwise mails are frequently flagged as spam. SPF/DKIM DNS records improve deliverability.
smtpHelp.test: "Test connection" verifies login and TLS handshake without sending an actual mail — safe to use before the first save.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.description: Manage login protection and data requests.

backup.title: My data & sync
backup.description: Control regular backups and cloud sync.
backup.adminNote: Backup settings are managed in the Admin panel.
backup.userNote: Backups are managed by the administrator.
backup.retentionDaysDescription: Backups older than {{days}} days will be automatically deleted

help.title: Backups & restore
help.description: A backup is a .tar.gz archive that freezes the full database and uploaded files (boarding passes, receipts) at a point in time.
help.scope: PostgreSQL dump (pg_dump) + the uploads/ directory. Logs and API caches are not backed up — they are reproducible.
help.admin: Management (manual trigger, download, restore, interval, cloud sync) happens in the admin panel. This section here is a read-only status view for non-admins.
help.restore: A restore completely replaces the existing database. Always create an extra backup beforehand using the checkbox in the restore dialog.

password.title: Change Password
password.error: Error changing password. Please check your current password.
password.tooShort: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
password.mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
password.sameAsOld: The new password must differ from the current one.

training.title: Training Settings
training.description: Configure the use of trained LLM models for better parsing accuracy
training.useTrainedModelsDescription: Automatically use trained models when available
training.preferredEmailModelDescription: Determines which model is used for email parsing
training.preferredVisionModelDescription: Determines which model is used for boarding pass parsing
training.trainingSeparateModelsDescription: Uses separate models for better specialization (recommended)

help.title: Training Settings
help.description: These settings control whether and how trained LLM models are used.

options.useTrainedModels: Enables automatic use of trained models when available
options.preferredEmailModel: Choose between Auto (trained if available), Trained (trained only) or Base (base model only)
options.preferredVisionModel: Same options for boarding pass parsing
options.trainingSeparateModels: Uses separate models for email and vision (recommended for better specialization)

developer.title: Developer Options
developer.description: Advanced features for parser development and debugging
developer.modeDescription: Enables access to the parser page with template management and parse logs
developer.confirmMessage: This unlocks advanced parser features that require technical understanding.

items.resourceUsage: LLM parsing (Ollama) requires a configured Ollama server
items.unexpectedResults: Template and regex parsers are experimental (beta)
items.longTraining: Custom templates require knowledge of the airline's email format

help.title: Developer Mode
help.description: Developer Mode enables advanced features for parser development.

items.trainingPage: Access to the parser page with annotation, templates, and parse logs
items.uploadAnnotation: Upload and annotate emails and boarding passes
items.loraTraining: Create custom regex templates from annotated data
items.parserAccuracy: Parse logs for analyzing and improving parsing results

items.ollama: For LLM parsing: Ollama server must be reachable (optional)
items.hardware: For LLM parsing: sufficient hardware resources (CPU/GPU, RAM)
items.trainingData: For custom templates: at least one annotated email

help.note: Only LLM-based parsing (Ollama) is fully tested. Template and regex parsers are experimental.

features.title: Features
features.costTrackingDesc: Show tax and fee fields on flight forms and enable business cost statistics. Price and currency are always available.
features.trackAircraftDesc: Persist aircraft registration + Mode-S from flight lookups. Off = aggregates only, no audit trail of specific airframes.

help.title: Optional features
help.description: Toggle features on and off to tailor the UI to your usage. Disabled features stay in the code and can be re-enabled any time.
help.cost: Shows the tax and fee fields on the flight forms and enables the business cost statistics. Price and currency are always available regardless — only the breakdown is optional, to keep the form lean.

parser.title: Parser Configuration
parser.description: Configure how boarding passes and emails are parsed. Auto mode automatically selects the best available parser.

modes.title: Parser Modes:
modes.autoDesc: Automatically selects the best available parser

bestPractices.title: Best Practices:
bestPractices.auto: Use "Auto" for the best balance between accuracy and cost
bestPractices.ollama: Ollama is ideal if you have a GPU and prefer local processing
bestPractices.cloud: Cloud parsers are most accurate but require API keys and incur costs
bestPractices.trained: Trained Ollama models (via Training page) significantly improve accuracy

autoUpdate.title: Automatic Updates
autoUpdate.description: Automatically fetch current flight data from APIs during active flights. Updates will be saved in the pending updates area for review.

info.title: How do automatic updates work?
info.description: When enabled, current flight data is regularly fetched from APIs during active flights. All found changes are saved in the pending updates area so you can review and approve them before they are applied to your flights.

benefits.title: Benefits:
benefits.realTime: Real-time updates: Get current flight data automatically during your flights
benefits.automatic: Automation: No more manual searching for flight changes needed
benefits.review: Control: All changes are saved for review before being applied
benefits.accurate: Accuracy: Uses multiple APIs for reliable and precise flight data
benefits.timeSaving: Time-saving: Save time by automatically updating your flight statistics

howItWorks.title: How it works:
howItWorks.description: The system checks for updates at configurable intervals (default: 15 minutes) during active flight times. Found changes such as delays, gate changes, or flight status are saved in the 'Pending Updates' area. You can review and approve or reject these changes individually.

requirement.title: Important note:
requirement.description: This feature only works with pre-entered flights, e.g. through email import or manual entry. Automatic updates are only performed for flights that are already in your flight list.

autoUpdate.checkIntervalDescription: How often the system checks for flight data updates
autoUpdate.onlyDuringFlightDescription: Only fetch updates during active flight times
autoUpdate.expiryHoursDescription: How long pending updates remain available before expiring

historicalEnrichment.title: Historical Enrichment
historicalEnrichment.description: Fills in missing flight data by aggregating reference flights with the same flight number

info.title: How does historical enrichment work?
info.description: The system finds flights with the same flight number that were live-tracked and aggregates their data. Depending on the age of the flight, different fields are filled in.

modes.title: Two enrichment modes:
modes.fullDescription: Flights < 1 year: aircraft type, ICAO codes, route, terminal, and gate are filled in.
modes.slimDescription: Flights ≥ 1 year: Only ICAO codes and terminal — aircraft type and route are too unreliable for older flights.

warning.title: Important:
warning.description: All suggestions are estimates based on similar flights. Each enrichment must be manually confirmed before it is saved.

historicalEnrichment.minConfidenceDescription: Only show suggestions with at least X% confidence
historicalEnrichment.maxPerDayDescription: Maximum number of new suggestions per night

apiKeys.title: API Keys
apiKeys.description: Manage API keys for external services. Keys shared by the administrator are automatically used.

help.title: External API keys
help.description: TravStats can enrich live flight data (positions, delays, gates) and additional airport information through third-party APIs. Every provider offers a free tier — keys are optional.
help.shared: If the administrator has configured a key for a provider, it is used automatically — you do not need to enter anything. Your own keys take precedence.
help.providers: Airlabs (general flight tracking, free tier with rate limit), Aviationstack (accurate schedule data, free 100/month tier), OpenSky (open-source flight tracker, requires client id + secret).
help.security: Keys are stored encrypted in the database and never sent back to the browser UI. After saving, the field only shows a placeholder dot pattern.

apiKeys.ownTooltip: Own API key entered - takes precedence over shared keys
apiKeys.notConfiguredTooltip: No API key configured - using shared key or ENV variable if available

historical365.label: Historical search · 365 days
historical365.tooltip: Only provider that reliably returns flights up to a year in the past.

quota.label: Remaining
quota.notReported: Provider does not return quota headers.
quota.rateLimitOnly: No monthly limit — IP-based rate limiting.

apiKeys.sharedNote: This key is shared by the administrator and cannot be edited

airlabs.label: AirLabs API Key
airlabs.description: Free tier: 1000 requests/month. Used for flight data lookup.

aviationstack.label: Aviationstack API Key
aviationstack.description: Paid service. Used for flight data lookup with higher accuracy.

aerodatabox.label: AeroDataBox API Key
aerodatabox.description: Free via RapidAPI: 600 units/month. Closes the gap for historical flights up to a year back.

bulkRefresh.title: Refresh existing flights
bulkRefresh.description: Backfill missing fields (tail number, Mode-S, codeshare flag, airline ICAO/IATA) on your existing flights from the last 365 days. Existing values are never overwritten. Requires AeroDataBox — only this provider covers the 365-day window.
bulkRefresh.allUpToDate: All flights in the 365-day window are up to date — nothing to do.
bulkRefresh.demoBlocked: Disabled on the demo account to avoid burning real API tokens. Available on your prod instance.
bulkRefresh.noHistoricalProvider: You need an AeroDataBox key to refresh flights older than today — only AeroDataBox covers the 365-day window. Enter a key above and reload the page.
bulkRefresh.confirmBody: This will use up to {{count}} AeroDataBox calls in this run. A single click processes at most 25 flights — click again to drain the remainder.
bulkRefresh.confirmHistoricalNote: Only AeroDataBox can serve the 365-day window. Other configured APIs (AirLabs, Aviationstack, OpenSky) are not used for this operation.
bulkRefresh.confirmQuotaCurrent: AeroDataBox quota: {{remaining}} of {{limit}} API units remaining.
bulkRefresh.confirmQuotaWarn: Remaining quota is below this batch — you will hit zero before completion.
bulkRefresh.summaryRetryHint: {{count}} more flights remain — click "Refresh" again to process the next batch.

opensky.label: OpenSky Network
opensky.description: Free service. Requires registration. Used for flight data lookup.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import existing data from other services — grouped per area.

log.title: Import log
log.scopeHint: Every bulk import as a whole, newest first. Only accommodation imports can currently be undone; flight imports are not logged here yet.

fr24.title: From Flightradar24
fr24.description: Upload your my.flightradar24.com CSV export. Timezone math + airport lookup auto-handled.

genericCsv.title: From any logbook (CSV)
genericCsv.description: Upload a flat per-flight CSV — after upload, a mapping wizard opens so you can match each column to a TravStats field.

flight.title: From e-mail or PDF
flight.description: Read an airline booking confirmation — the usual route. Opens in the flight dialog, where the review of several flights happens.

cruise.title: From e-mail or PDF
cruise.description: Read a cruise line booking confirmation (AIDA, TUI and generic) — with a preview before committing.

lodging.title: From e-mail or PDF
lodging.description: Read a hotel confirmation, e.g. from Booking.com — with a preview before committing.

warningBadge.duration_mismatch: Duration mismatch — using calculated arrival from departure + duration

wizard.title: Map your CSV columns to TravStats fields
wizard.duplicateMappingHint: One CSV column is mapped to two TravStats fields — please resolve

toast.movedFromDashboard: The flight import has moved here — under Settings → Import.

import.noRoutes: No import route for this area yet.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Connect the TravStats app on your phone. Scan the QR code in the app to pair the device — a device-bound token is created automatically.
devices.qrHint: Open the app → Settings → "Connect device" and scan this code.
devices.noPublicUrl: No public URL is configured. Set a public address in the admin settings so the app can reach the server.
devices.confirmUnpair: Really sign out this device? The app on it will lose access immediately.

apiTokens.title: API Tokens
apiTokens.description: Personal access tokens for AI agents, scripts, and external apps. To connect the TravStats app, use "Devices" instead. A token is shown exactly once at creation — never again.
apiTokens.docsBody: Full endpoints, examples and schemas — try them interactively with your token.
apiTokens.confirmRevoke: Really revoke this token? External tools using it will lose access immediately.
apiTokens.justCreatedWarning: Copy this token NOW — it will not be shown again. Only the hash is persisted.
